import repro_project_dsl

type
  Csm12toolPackage* = object
  Csm12toolPackageExecutable* = object
    value*: SelectedExecutable

const csm12tool* = Csm12toolPackage()

proc executable*(pkg: Csm12toolPackage; name: string): Csm12toolPackageExecutable =
  discard pkg
  Csm12toolPackageExecutable(value: selectedExecutable("csm12tool", name))

proc greet*( exe: Csm12toolPackageExecutable; jobs: int = 0; verbose: bool = false; who: string): PublicCliCall =
  publicCliCall(exe.value.packageName, exe.value.executableName, "greet", exe.value.packageName & "." & exe.value.executableName & ".greet", @[cliArg("jobs", jobs, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("verbose", verbose, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("who", who, cpkPositional, 0, "")])

proc count*( exe: Csm12toolPackageExecutable; jobs: int = 0; verbose: bool = false; upTo: int = 0): PublicCliCall =
  publicCliCall(exe.value.packageName, exe.value.executableName, "count", exe.value.packageName & "." & exe.value.executableName & ".count", @[cliArg("jobs", jobs, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("verbose", verbose, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("upTo", upTo, cpkFlag, 0, "")])

proc greet*( pkg: Csm12toolPackage; jobs: int = 0; verbose: bool = false; who: string): PublicCliCall =
  discard pkg
  publicCliCall("csm12tool", "csm12tool", "greet", "csm12tool.csm12tool.greet", @[cliArg("jobs", jobs, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("verbose", verbose, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("who", who, cpkPositional, 0, "")])

proc count*( pkg: Csm12toolPackage; jobs: int = 0; verbose: bool = false; upTo: int = 0): PublicCliCall =
  discard pkg
  publicCliCall("csm12tool", "csm12tool", "count", "csm12tool.csm12tool.count", @[cliArg("jobs", jobs, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("verbose", verbose, cpkFlag, 0, ""), cliArg("upTo", upTo, cpkFlag, 0, "")])
